responses.reason: Lev.23.23 and 23.26 each begin with וידבר יהוה אל־משה לאמר. The second speech changes date, observance, requirements, sanctions, and relates formally to Lev.16.29-34. Splitting at 23.26 while preserving the Lev.23 calendar parent is well supported.

Lev.26.1-2 continues imperative allegiance language without a new speech formula; Lev.26.3 begins an explicit אם protasis with coordinated verbs תלכו, תשמרו, ועשיתם, followed by the consequence sequence at 26.4. The syntax supports an alternate seam at 26.3, but retaining the two-verse frame with the blessing at low confidence avoids detachment and preserves the uninterrupted Lev.25.1-26.46 Sinai discourse.

Lev.23.1 supplies the divine-speech formula; Lev.23.4 does not repeat that full formula but repeats the nominal heading אלה מועדי יהוה and changes from weekly Sabbath to the dated annual calendar. The combined lexical reset and calendrical function change support the seam while the Lev.23 parent preserves the overarching appointed-times relation.

Lev.18.24 begins אל־תטמאו בכל־אלה and repeats בכל־אלה, making 18.24-30 explicitly anaphoric and causally dependent on the preceding prohibitions. Its rationale-and-sanction function nevertheless differs from the prohibition series. Retaining both children beneath a required Lev.18.1-30 parent preserves grammar and retrieval function.

Lev.17.15 opens a new וכל־נפש אשר תאכל condition governing נבלה וטרפה, washing, temporary impurity, and cleansing. This is a genuine form shift from blood prohibition and hunted-game draining, and it corresponds formally to Lev.11.39-40. Retaining the resident-inclusive consumption speech as one low-confidence chunk with an internal seam avoids a weak two-verse standalone unit.

WEB Lev.6.1-7 corresponds to MT/OSHB Lev.5.20-26; WEB Lev.6.8 begins MT/OSHB Lev.6.1. The offset continues through WEB 6.30 and resynchronizes at Lev.7.1. These are versification labels, not literary authority.

The required subordinate maps preserve real function changes without over-fragmenting complete procedures or legal lists. This satisfies H-LEV-001 and records subordinate structure at Lev.1.1-2, 11.46-47, 20.27, 24.1-9, and 27.26-34.
